reviews.text: Best latte in Springfield, hands down. The baristas remember my order and the riverside patio is perfect on weekends. Already planning my next visit.
Took my parents here for brunch and everything was excellent — avocado toast, cappuccinos, and friendly service. Feels like a neighborhood gem.
Their seasonal lavender cold brew is incredible. Clean space, quick service, and they compost their grounds — love the values behind the brand.
Finally a coffee shop that does flat whites properly. Smooth milk, balanced shot, and they never rush you out the door.
Brought friends visiting from out of town and everyone raved about the house blend. Atmosphere is warm without being trendy for trendy’s sake.
Solid pour-over and a cozy atmosphere for remote work. Wi‑Fi was steady. Only knock is limited pastry options by mid-afternoon.
Friendly team and consistently good espresso. Parking nearby can be tricky on Saturdays, but worth the stop.
Great place to meet clients. Espresso drinks are reliable and the almond croissant sells out early for a reason.
